rationale: Single RFx notice on worldbank.org - one-off artifact evidencing a WB/NBRSM e-payments diagnostic, not a recurring feed.
Global Findex is a durable, recurring demand-side dataset with MK indicators for payments market sizing.
EPC SEPA participant register is a structured, continuously updated list of MK PSP adherence - core competitor/readiness signal.
ECB Data Portal is a standalone statistical API/portal giving the comparative frame for MK payment statistics.
Wayback CDX API is a standalone tool for recovering deleted MK bank/vendor reference pages; unique retrospective capability.
ASEE newsroom is a primary competitor-vendor press stream covering MK deals; monitor continuously.
EMIS company profiles are behind a commercial subscription; mine once for vendor entity/partner data if access cleared.
bne IntelliNews is a durable regional news feed but largely paywalled; needs subscription clearance.
Public regional policy outlet with steady enlargement-report coverage; useful but secondary context feed.
EBRD newsroom/project database names MK counterpart banks and digitalisation facilities - leading indicator of vendor demand.
EIB press feed is standalone and public; complements EBRD on financing of MK bank IT modernisation.
The Paypers is a continuous English-language payments trade feed picking up MK scheme/processor news.
Vendor customer-list database of modest credibility, mostly gated; mine once for Asseco CBS bank references.
Single OSOR country report page - useful evidence on MK e-gov rails; parent portal would be the monitorable source.
BIS central bankers' speeches index is a durable English archive carrying NBRSM payments-modernisation intent.
Statutory NBRSM register of payment institutions - definitive MK payments competitor list; verification failure is soft only.
Statutory register of payment system operators naming KIBS/MIPS infrastructure incumbents; distinct dataset from the PI register.
Explainer hub on nbrm.mk covered by monitoring the NBRSM payments section; adds context, not standalone signal.
Static regulator description of KIBS; a sub-page of the NBRSM payment-infrastructure parent - pointer to KIBS AD itself.
NBStat statistical database with documented API is a standalone machine-readable series of MK payments/banking data.
Consolidated PSD2-transposing law page updates with amendments; defines licence taxonomy for the whole cell.
Index of payments secondary legislation - regulatory change here is the earliest demand signal; worth continuous watch.
Single decision page under the NBRSM regulation index; schema reference rather than a standalone monitored source.
Recurring annual payments-developments report directory on NBRSM; durable series for market-trend framing.
Advisory-body sub-page on nbrm.mk with sparse updates; useful stakeholder map, covered by the NBRSM parent.
Authoritative licensed-bank directory - the MK buyer universe for payments technology; changes on licensing events.
Static bank identifier list; mine once as a join key for entity reconciliation across registers and statistics.
